metadata.data_source: OECD Government at a Glance 2023; authors' GPRD analysis

conservative.label: Conservative — attenuated TWFE sensitivity
conservative.description: All EU Member States implement reforms achieving the attenuated conventional TWFE sensitivity (-0.71 pp) over 5 years. This is an illustrative lower-bound scenario; the primary staggered DiD estimate is -7.2 pp but is not used for this conservative input.
conservative.confidence: illustrative lower-bound — TWFE is attenuated and imprecise

moderate.label: Moderate — Full e-procurement + transparency
moderate.description: Comprehensive digital reform combining e-procurement mandates, open contracting data standards, and proactive market engagement. Assumes a 5 pp reduction over 10 years as a broader reform scenario rather than a direct extrapolation from the attenuated TWFE sensitivity.
moderate.confidence: medium — extrapolated from multiple reform cases

ambitious.label: Ambitious — Nordic-level governance
ambitious.description: Convergence to Nordic governance standards (Denmark, Finland, Sweden average SB rate ≈ 8%).  Requires institutional reform, professionalised procurement, and sustained political commitment.

sensitivity.note: Sensitivity of conservative scenario to ±1 SE and ±2 SE of the attenuated TWFE sensitivity; negative reductions are clipped to zero for projection magnitudes
